visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with black hair in a ponytail wearing a black hoodie stands in a bright indoor kitchen. An adult's hands are visible, using a yellow spatula to guide flour into a red KitchenAid stand mixer bowl. The background features white pegboards with kitchen utensils. (2) The girl holds a metal flour sifter with both hands over a stainless steel bowl as an adult pours more flour in. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The girl is shown in a close-up, carefully using a spoon to press flour through the sifter while looking down with a serious expression. (4) The scene shifts to the girl using a yellow spatula to scrape light-colored dough from the large mixer bowl. (5) The girl and adult are rolling out dough together on a white surface covered with parchment paper using a wooden rolling pin. The girl pushes the pin forward with effort. (6) The girl uses a pink number '4' shaped cookie cutter to press shapes into the yellow dough sheet. Her small hands are seen carefully removing the excess dough. (7) A close-up shows the raw dough shaped like a '4' with a small crown on a pink silicone baking mat. (8) The baked, golden-brown cookies are displayed on the same mat in neat rows. (9) The girl helps an adult place individual cookies into small clear plastic bags. The girl wears a white long-sleeved shirt now. (10) The girl sits at a wooden table and applies round white stickers to the cookie packages. Many sticker sheets are scattered around. (11) A hand holds up a finished white gift bag containing the packaged cookies, showing a complete birthday favor.

(3) A female adult voice is heard speaking clearly in Traditional Chinese, encouraging the child with rising intonation: '用力，對，好'. The tone is warm and high-pitched.
